name: mafk-24-7-retail-flow-pos
description: MAFK-24/7 Retail-Flow POS - multi-tenant retail POS platform

scripts.build: pnpm run build:libs && pnpm --filter @mafk/api --filter @mafk/web --filter @mafk/desktop run build
scripts.typecheck: pnpm run build:libs && pnpm -r --workspace-concurrency=1 run typecheck
scripts.test: pnpm --filter @mafk/shared --filter @mafk/validation run build && pnpm --filter @mafk/shared --filter @mafk/api --filter @mafk/web --filter @mafk/desktop run test
scripts.verify: pnpm run typecheck && pnpm run lint && pnpm run format:check && pnpm run test && pnpm run build && pnpm run scan:secrets && pnpm run scan:security && pnpm run scan:windows
